criterion: A roadway tree tunnel needs branches above the pavement and substantial continuous overhead enclosure. Roadside greenery, median plantings, shade from structures, and adjacent trail canopy do not establish a roadway tunnel.

sampling_limits: 24 KartaView photos at 19 sampled locations/road stretches (some dates share a location). Initial controls include adjacent trails and freeways. Eight map candidates were sampled at directly overlapping KartaView coverage, but only three roadway locations had conclusive framing. Captures span 2017–2022. They are historical evidence, not current field verification or a statistical accuracy estimate.

candidate_observations.positive: State St: substantial overhead enclosure in 2017 capture; current condition unverified.
false_positives: University Rd: divided street and planted median misrepresent road enclosure. Two opposite-direction photos show open lanes.
Mesa Rd: some overhanging canopy but broad central sky; does not meet the continuous enclosure criterion.
unresolved: West Hollister Ave, Ninos Dr and Wentworth Ave: side-facing framing.
North San Marcos Rd: intersection framing.
filter_feedback: Use road-center and both-side canopy instead of general nearby greenery.
Inspect divided roads and planted medians for centerline misalignment before trusting a high canopy score.
Only attach a positive roadway verification when image position, visible road, direction, and context actually match the candidate.

Include pedestrian-designated streets: current OSM State Street is pedestrian/motor_vehicle=no, despite its useful historical tunnel evidence. Generic footways and cycling trails remain separate from street-level roadway evidence.
candidate_observations.limits: This targeted sample is too small and imagery too old to estimate map-wide precision or recall; qualitative feedback only.
candidate_observations.data_selection_feedback: TIGER centerlines can occupy planted medians or mapped road continuations beyond real pavement. Replace them with OpenStreetMap geometry and explicit road tags before final ranking.

final_matches.criterion: Exact normalized street name and image position within 20 m of a candidate; KartaView matches also require roadway context. This associates historical imagery with a candidate and does not verify current tunnel conditions.
